senses.gloss: (reduplic. of אב, עב, עו; v. עַוִּית) prop. swelling, heaviness (cmp. כאב), hence disorder of the stomach, vomiting (spasms); usu. in connection with חמה, fever with vomiting.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 19">Gen. R. s. 19</cite> did you ever hear, this ass here that is driven out <he>חמה עליה אבבית עליה</he> Ar. (ed. corrup. <he>צינה עליו כמה חככים עליו</he>) has fever, has vomiting (spasms)? <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 53:13">Gen. R. s. 53</cite> <he>חמה ואכאבית</he>. V. <cite ref="A00021"><he>אַכְאָבִית</he></cite>.
